summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K covering two items: (1) a non-material amendment to a manufacturing and supply agreement clarifying inventory title transfer and transition management between Napo and Woodward, and (2) the automatic conversion of Series O Convertible Preferred Stock into common stock at a fixed ratio of 3.209:1, effective June 25, 2026. The conversion is described as optional per the certificate of designation. No board recommendation, advisor, or strategic event is present. This is a routine contractual amendment and a mandatory preferred stock conversion, not a special situation.
